ADVISORY ONLY — this table is NOT consumed by any codeSyntax stamping, emit, or gap-report pass in this repo, and nothing in src/ reads this file programmatically. It exists for a human or an agent adapting raw MCP `get_design_context` output to consult by hand, because the m3-kit copy ships zero spacing/density Figma variables (evidence #13: 304 variables total, 0 in a spacing family) to stamp codeSyntax onto in the first place. Between-component layout spacing therefore stays literal px in v1 (architecture §1: design/Figma is authoritative on visual intent; auto-rewriting px risks breaking visual parity with the design). Values assume Tailwind v4's default `--spacing` scale (1 unit = 0.25rem = 4px at the default 16px root font-size), which tailwind-m3e-web does not override (verified: no `--spacing` redeclaration in its src/theme.css). Rows marked `measuredInEvidence4: true` are the literal px values evidence #4 actually observed in a real `get_design_context` frame render (Examples/Messaging-Mobile 56615:46684) — the rest of the table extrapolates the same scale for completeness, not from a second measurement.
appliesTo: between-component (layout) spacing only — NOT component-internal spacing, which components handle themselves at runtime via tailwind-m3e-web's density-0..3 scope utilities (--md-sys-density-scale). See docs/density-and-spacing.md for the full split.
